title: Four-day pilot recommendation
prompt: Recommend whether a 120-person software company should run a six-week four-day-workweek pilot using the supplied attendance and delivery data.
deliverable: Decision memo with recommendation, risks, and next steps

title: Library hours allocation
prompt: Advise a city library director how to reallocate 40 weekly staff hours across three branches using the supplied visit and program data.

title: Vendor incident response
prompt: Recommend a response to a payroll vendor outage, distinguishing immediate containment from the longer-term contract decision.

title: How heat pumps work
prompt: Explain how an air-source heat pump heats a home in cold weather, including efficiency limits and backup heat.

title: Confidence intervals
prompt: Explain what a 95 percent confidence interval does and does not mean, using one concrete polling example.

title: Passkeys and passwords
prompt: Explain how passkeys authenticate a user, what remains on the device, and how account recovery changes.

title: Curbside space is public space
prompt: Argue for a transparent system that prices and allocates downtown curb space among deliveries, parking, transit, and accessibility needs.

title: Repairable school laptops
prompt: Make the case for school districts to include repairability and total cost of ownership in laptop procurement.
deliverable: Opinion column addressing the strongest objection

title: Publish public meeting data
prompt: Argue that municipalities should publish agendas, minutes, and voting records as structured data as well as PDFs.
deliverable: Persuasive op-ed with a practical proposal

title: CSV validation library
prompt: Document a small command-line library that validates CSV schemas, emits JSON diagnostics, and supports stdin.
deliverable: README with install, quick start, options, examples, and limitations

title: Local photo organizer
prompt: Document a privacy-first desktop tool that organizes photos locally using dates and user-created tags.
deliverable: README with setup, workflow, privacy model, and troubleshooting

title: Webhook test server
prompt: Document a development server that captures webhooks, verifies signatures, and replays requests.
deliverable: README with tested examples and security cautions

title: Transit reliability review
prompt: Condense the supplied service review into the decisions, causes, uncertainties, and three prioritized actions most relevant to the transit board.

title: Warehouse safety audit
prompt: Summarize the supplied audit findings, separating urgent hazards from systemic contributors and longer-term improvements.

title: Customer research synthesis
prompt: Summarize interviews about onboarding friction, quantify the strength of themes, and identify decisions the evidence does not yet support.

title: Urban trees and heat
prompt: Synthesize the supplied studies on urban tree canopy and neighborhood heat, comparing methods, findings, and equity implications.

title: Retrieval practice
prompt: Review the supplied research on retrieval practice in secondary education, noting outcome measures, boundary conditions, and evidence quality.

title: Remote work and collaboration
prompt: Synthesize the supplied empirical literature on remote work's effects on collaboration and innovation without collapsing distinct study designs.

title: Procurement concentration
prompt: Use the supplied contract records to determine whether one vendor's growing share reflects consolidation, repeat awards, or a change in categorization.

title: Missing inspection records
prompt: Reconcile the supplied inspection logs and agency statements to explain a six-month reporting gap and identify what remains unverified.

title: Grant outcome claims
prompt: Test a nonprofit's public outcome claims against the supplied grant filings, annual reports, and program data.

title: API client comparison
prompt: Compare three supplied API clients on installation, authentication, retries, pagination, and error diagnostics using the locked test protocol.

title: PDF extraction tools
prompt: Compare the supplied PDF text extractors on a fixed corpus, reporting accuracy, failure modes, speed, and environmental constraints.

title: Static site build performance
prompt: Benchmark three supplied static-site configurations using the locked fixture and distinguish cold builds, warm builds, and output correctness.
deliverable: Benchmark report with methodology and uncertainty
